children: Everus completed the $295 million cash acquisition of Epsilon Industries to bolster its off-site modular construction and expand reach into data center, advanced manufacturing and healthcare markets.
Acquisition completed for $295 million in cash, subject to customary closing adjustments.
Epsilon adds modular mechanical and electrical building infrastructure capabilities across U.S. and Canada.
Transaction expected to complement off-site construction, expand geographic reach and enhance key end‑market presence.
Epsilon will remain led by existing leadership, including President Chris Wiederick.
Everus funded the deal with cash on hand and borrowings; will update full‑year 2026 forecast in Q3 earnings.
